A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same S(H)NAP audit of Sybil. Their main text, Appendices A–C, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–31 are readable and support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction benchmarks, radiologist evaluations, attribution analyses on LUNA25 and iLDCT, and nodule-insertion experiments, including extensive appendix results.

after.justification: v2 retains the original reconstruction benchmarks, radiologist evaluations, attribution analyses, and insertion experiments in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The SDB-based nodule interventions, SHNAP and gSHNAP decompositions, and SNAP insertion procedure are unchanged. Appendix Algorithms 1 and 2 retain the same steps.

E1.justification: Both versions use NLST, LUNA25, and iLDCT for the same training and evaluation roles. Nodule removal, insertion, region-based attribution, longitudinal cases, and spatial sensitivity scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Gaussian noise, sample mean, Lung-DDPM (labeled Lungs-DDPM), and MAISIv2. Appendix C.8 also retains the same four naive replacement baselines; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The splits, preprocessing, metrics, training configuration, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both report 3,226 reconstruction samples, radiologist evaluations of 40 cubes and 110 scan pairs, insertion timestep 0.3, and 240 patient–nodule combinations.

E4.justification: Both retain interaction-order comparisons, attribution stability analyses, naive-baseline comparisons, random-region controls, longitudinal failure cases, and radial sensitivity analyses. Appendices C.7–C.14 contain the same supplementary evidence.

E5.justification: Both report five independent attribution runs, binomial confidence intervals and tests, a response-bias Z-test, two-way ANOVA, Tukey’s HSD, and regression significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run count changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 is numerically identical, including mean FID 0.0417 for the proposed method and 0.4887 for MAISIv2. Figure 3 retains accuracy 0.575, and Section 5.4 retains regression R² values 0.071 and 0.455. The remaining plots and qualitative findings are also retained.

T1.justification: Definitions, Equations (1)–(16), Hypothesis 1, Theorem 4.1, and the appendix mathematical explanations are unchanged. Expanded equation-reference wording does not revise the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain the same contributions: generative interventions, SHNAP/SNAP explanations, pairwise approximation of Sybil, and identification of artifacts and radial bias. The new Impact Statement reiterates these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of nodule contributions, anatomical biases, and background effects remain unchanged, as do limitations concerning synthetic artifacts and large nodules. The new Impact Statement repeats the existing auditing and clinical-safety rationale without adding a substantive qualification.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains the same implementation, preprocessing, hyperparameters, and approximately 1,600 A100-hours of training. New acknowledgments identify computing-support institutions but add no technical configuration, reproduction procedure, or code/data access instructions.

R1.justification: Section 6 replaces the Optellum reference to Massion et al. (2022), concerning clinicians’ interpretation, with a differently titled Massion et al. (2020) risk-stratification study. Broader research positioning is unchanged; same-title author and venue updates elsewhere are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Impact Statement and acknowledgments, updates an equal-contribution marker and publication footer, standardizes cross-reference wording, and revises bibliographic metadata. The main narrative and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves below the introductory text in the first page’s right column. Text, figure spacing, and page breaks also change, including around the new disclosure sections. The same Table 1 and Figures 1–31 are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves attribution and reporting through clearer bibliographic identification, including replacing 'M et al.' with 'Musthafa et al.' for the same-titled work, and explicit funding, computing-support, and contributor acknowledgments. The scientific methods, evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited.
